tools.name: consult
tools.title: Run a Industrious session
tools.description: Run a Industrious session (API or ChatGPT browser automation). Use `files` to attach project context. If `engine` is omitted, Industrious follows CLI defaults: config/ORACLE_ENGINE first, then API when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, otherwise browser. Browser ChatGPT Pro consults can take many minutes; set `waitForCompletion:false` to return a durable sessionId immediately, then use `wait` to block without agent-side polling. Use `dryRun:true` first when configuring an agent and inspect `sessions`/`industrious status` before retrying. Browser manual-login uses a private Industrious Chrome profile separate from the user's normal Chrome; dry-run output includes first-time setup guidance when that path is active. For browser-based image/file uploads, set `browserAttachments:"always"`. For ChatGPT image generation, set `generateImage` to enable the same image wait/download path as CLI --generate-image and read returned paths from `images`. Browser consults can include `browserFollowUps` for a multi-turn ChatGPT review in one conversation. Sessions are stored under `ORACLE_HOME_DIR` (shared with the CLI).

preset.description: Optional MCP convenience preset. "chatgpt-pro-heavy" selects ChatGPT browser mode, gpt-6-pro (GPT-6 model radio), and Pro thinking unless overridden.

files.description: Optional file paths or glob patterns (like the CLI `--file`). Resolved relative to the MCP server working directory.

model.description: Single model name/label. If `engine` is omitted, Industrious follows CLI defaults: config/ORACLE_ENGINE first, then `api` when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, otherwise `browser`. Prefer setting `engine` explicitly to avoid default surprises.

models.description: Multi-model fan-out (API engine only). Cannot be combined with browser automation.

engine.description: Execution engine. `api` uses provider APIs. `browser` uses ChatGPT automation or the local Gemini web client according to the model. Picker labels apply to ChatGPT only. When omitted, Industrious follows CLI defaults: config/ORACLE_ENGINE first, then `api` when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, otherwise `browser`.

browserModelLabel.description: Browser-only: explicit ChatGPT UI label to select (overrides model mapping). Example: "GPT-5.2 Thinking".

browserAttachments.description: Browser-only: how to deliver `files`. "auto" (default) and "always" use real ChatGPT uploads. The "never" mode rejects resolved files because inline source cannot be verified.

browserBundleFiles.description: Browser-only: force one upload bundle; auto/zip includes all resolved files. Multiple text/source uploads already bundle by default (flattened text unless ZIP is selected).

browserBundleFormat.description: Browser-only: bundle upload format. Defaults to "auto", which keeps flattened text for text-only uploads and uses ZIP when raw files are present; "zip" forces a byte-preserving archive.

browserThinkingTime.description: Browser-only: set ChatGPT thinking time when supported by the chosen model.

browserFallback.description: Explicit consent to consult grok.com once in a separate Private profile after ChatGPT fails and its bounded read-only recovery expires; the original ChatGPT request is retained for recovery.

browserModelStrategy.description: Browser-only: model picker strategy. Mirrors the CLI --browser-model-strategy flag.

browserResearchMode.description: Browser-only: explicitly select ChatGPT Web Search or Deep Research.

browserArchive.description: Browser-only: archive completed ChatGPT conversations after local artifacts are saved. "auto" archives successful non-project one-shots only.

browserFollowUps.description: Browser-only: additional prompts to submit sequentially in the same ChatGPT conversation after the initial answer.

browserKeepBrowser.description: Browser-only: keep Chrome running after completion (useful for debugging).

generateImage.description: Browser-only: save generated image(s) to this file path. For ChatGPT browser mode this enables the image-aware wait/download path used by CLI --generate-image.

outputPath.description: Browser-only image output fallback path, mirroring the CLI --output option for image operations.

waitForCompletion.description: When false, start the Industrious run in a detached worker and return its sessionId immediately. Use the wait tool to block for completion without agent-side polling. Defaults to true for compatibility.

dryRun.description: Preview the resolved Industrious run without creating a session or touching the browser.

search.description: API-only: enable/disable the provider search tool (browser engine ignores this).

slug.description: Optional human-friendly session id (used later with `industrious session <id>`).

message.const: Artifact publication succeeded and was verified, but staging cleanup failed; residual staging data may remain.

tools.name: chatgpt_image
tools.title: Generate an image with ChatGPT
tools.description: Agent-friendly wrapper for ChatGPT browser image generation. It selects browser mode, enables the image-aware wait/download path, uploads reference files when provided, and returns saved image paths in structuredContent.images.

files.description: Optional reference image/file paths or globs to upload to ChatGPT.

outputPath.description: Where to save the first generated image. Defaults to a unique file under ORACLE_HOME_DIR/generated/.

aspectRatio.description: Optional requested image aspect ratio, e.g. "1:1", "9:16", or "16:9".

model.description: Optional ChatGPT/browser model label or alias. Defaults follow Industrious config.

browserModelLabel.description: Explicit ChatGPT UI model label to select.

browserAttachments.description: How to deliver files. Defaults to "always" when files are present so reference images are uploaded.

browserThinkingTime.description: Set ChatGPT thinking time when supported by the chosen model.

browserModelStrategy.description: Model picker strategy. Mirrors the consult tool and CLI browser flag.

browserArchive.description: Archive completed ChatGPT conversations after local artifacts are saved.

browserKeepBrowser.description: Keep Chrome running after completion for debugging.

dryRun.description: Preview the resolved image run without touching the browser.

message.const: Artifact publication succeeded and was verified, but staging cleanup failed; residual staging data may remain.

tools.name: project_sources
tools.title: Manage ChatGPT Project Sources
tools.description: List or append files to a ChatGPT Project's persistent Sources tab. This is useful for Developer Mode workflows where chats do not share memory, but explicit project sources provide shared context. Destructive delete/replace/sync operations are intentionally not included in v1.

operation.description: Project Sources operation. v1 intentionally supports only non-destructive list/add.

chatgptUrl.description: ChatGPT project URL ending in /project. Falls back to browser.chatgptUrl config.

files.description: Local file paths or globs to add as persistent ChatGPT Project Sources.

dryRun.description: Validate files and return an upload plan without touching the browser.

confirmMutation.description: Required for mutating add operations so agents do not modify project state accidentally.

tools.name: sessions
tools.title: List or fetch industrious sessions
tools.description: Inspect Industrious session history stored under `ORACLE_HOME_DIR` (shared with the CLI). List recent sessions or fetch one by id/slug (optionally including metadata + request + log).

id.description: Session id or slug. If set, returns a single session (use detail:true to include metadata/request).

hours.description: Look back this many hours when listing sessions (default: 24).

limit.description: Maximum sessions to return when listing (default: 100).

includeAll.description: Include sessions outside the time window when listing (mirrors `industrious status --all`).

detail.description: When id is set, include session metadata + stored request + full log text.

tools.name: wait
tools.title: Wait for a Industrious session
tools.description: Wait for an existing Industrious session to reach a terminal state without agent-side polling. Omit timeoutMs to wait indefinitely, or set a bounded caller wait. Wait timeout or request cancellation never cancels the Industrious session; call wait again with the same id to continue waiting.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a terminal session state. Omit to wait indefinitely; 0 returns an immediate snapshot. A wait timeout never cancels the Industrious session.

message.const: Artifact publication succeeded and was verified, but staging cleanup failed; residual staging data may remain.
